VLAN 784 gets ports GigabitEthernet1/1/17, GigabitEthernet1/1/7, GigabitEthernet1/1/14, GigabitEthernet1/1/13, and GigabitEthernet1/1/12. Bring all access ports up.
config:
hostname switch1
!
vlan 317
 name Annex
!
vlan 933

!
vlan 784

!
